decisions.title: Standalone domain-neutral engine boundaries
invariants: Engine packages cannot import dependent applications
Core contracts cannot contain marine-specific terms
HTTP, worker, and persistence adapters depend inward on domain contracts

decisions.title: Fail-closed tenant authorization
invariants: Every tenant resource is addressed by organization ID
Authorization requires authenticated subject, active membership, and explicit permission
Missing, revoked, or cross-tenant context is denied before resource lookup

decisions.title: Versioned contracts and idempotent side effects
invariants: External request and event contracts are versioned
Retried commands use tenant-scoped idempotency keys
Committed side effects publish through a transactional outbox
negativeTests: idempotency key reuse with different input is rejected
uncommitted outbox event is not published
